dedupe_keys.name: nlr next generation hydrogen station composite data products deployment safety maintenance failure and fuelling performance of us hydrogen stations

description: The Next Generation Hydrogen Station composite data products (CDPs) are National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly NREL) aggregated charts and data on US hydrogen fuelling stations, for all stations (retail and non-retail combined) with a separate set for retail stations. Contents: deployment (cumulative stations, stations by type, station timeline); safety (safety report factors, equipment involved, event descriptions, fills and hydrogen dispensed per leak); maintenance and reliability (maintenance by equipment type, labour hours, repair time by equipment category, failure modes for top equipment categories, compressor maintenance, maintenance costs, mean fills and amount dispensed between failures, reliability growth and historical failure rates, and cause-and-effect breakdowns for sensors, software, dispensers, nozzles and compressor valves and seals); and performance (hydrogen dispensed and fills by quarter, region, hour and pressure, fuelling rates, times, amounts and final pressures at 350 and 700 bar). Producer: NLR Hydrogen and Fuel Cells programme. Coverage: US next generation hydrogen stations; the CDPs listed carry dates from October 2017 to May 2018. Format and access: charts on the NLR page (CDP INFR series numbers). Licence: not stated on the NLR page. Caveats: data are aggregated to protect station operators and the listed products date from 2017 and 2018. Simulation uses: failure rates, repair times and demand patterns for reliability and capacity models of hydrogen refuelling networks. Related records: model-nlr-sera-hydrogen-supply-chain-infrastructure-optimisation and data-policy-aware-hydrogen-refuelling-reproduction.
